description.value:
Effect: You no longer need line of effect to give commands to any minions you can summon. Additionally, choose one of the following benefits:

  • For the Boss:
    Your followers gain a +3 bonus to project rolls that they make.

  • Networker:
    Your maximum follower count increases by 1.

  • Stringpuller:
    While occupying a civilized area (such as a village, town, district, or city), you always have access to a follower native to the location. If the area is otherwise hostile to you, this follower is a spy in hiding who has any project points they earn halved.

prerequisites.value: You complete three downtime projects during the same respite with the help of followers or minions.

system.story: Don't worry. I've got a guy.
